mutations.label: the scan goes back to Monday, and the blind window between an upstream change and anyone learning of it is a week again (#705)
the night job stops running under always(), so the one night it exists for, a failed scan, skips the job that would report it
mutations.find:
if: always() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      issues: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/night-report.yml
mutations.replace:
if: github.event_name == 'schedule' && always()
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      issues: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/night-report.yml

mutations.label: the pull request opens every scheduled night whatever the scan found, which teaches everyone to close them unread
mutations.find:
if: github.event_name == 'schedule' && needs.drift.outputs.changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write        # push the branch
mutations.replace:
if: github.event_name == 'schedule' && (needs.drift.outputs.changed == 'true' || true)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write        # push the branch

mutations.label: a skipped job counts as red, so every quiet night, propose and report skipped, opens the red-night issue
